content_of_post_to_answer: What are the biggest signs that your daily routine needs improvement?
answer: A daily routine often needs improvement not when it looks unproductive, but when it quietly stops supporting the person you are becoming. A common sign is feeling busy all day yet unable to point to anything meaningful that moved forward. The deeper issue is usually not lack of discipline, but a mismatch between your habits and your priorities. A routine should not only manage your time; it should protect your energy, attention, and the things you actually value.
